steps.note: quadraui#1303 bugbash shape, as a shared conformance scenario: a StatusBar whose right_segments follow the documented least-important-first / cursor-last convention must keep its cursor-position segment ('Ln 1, Col 1') visible once a left segment grows (the 'd' key here simulates an editor's unsaved-changes '[+]' badge), even when that growth forces priority-drop to shed a lower-priority right segment ('Spaces: 4'). This is a regression guard on the existing, correct contract (StatusBar::fit_right_start / layout_padded already drop strictly front-to-back and always preserve the last element) proven across every registered backend, not a reproduction of a quadraui-side defect — the bugbash's actual root cause is a vimcode call-site that orders its cursor segment first instead of last, which this fixture deliberately does NOT do.
